name: Big Bass Floats My Boat

features.name: Fisherman retriggers

review:
Big Bass Floats My Boat adds a base-game feature and a position-based multiplier to the series. On the familiar 5x3, 10-line reels, landed fish can be collected at random during any spin, with the displayed prize multiplied by up to 50x. That gives the base game a reason to pay attention, which many Big Bass titles lack.

Three or more scatters award up to 20 free spins. During the bonus, each fish that lands adds a growing multiplier to its reel position, so later fish landing on the same spot are worth more. Every four fisherman wilds award a retrigger. Pragmatic Play's page doesn't list a maximum win. The 96.07% RTP is in line with recent entries. It's one of the more inventive Big Bass variations.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
